verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev is a platform for building AI agents and workflows, so letting its agents or tasks consume external MCP servers' tools is a fair question to ask. The evidence only documents Trigger.dev's own official MCP server, which lets AI assistants control Trigger.dev projects. That is the server role and does not show the product can connect to third-party MCP servers as a client. Nothing in the pack shows MCP client support.
